title: Capture clap error continuation lines + extract subcommand for repair
diff_sketch: src/cli/mod.rs::clap_error_message walks past blank lines instead of aborting on the first one. New helper extract_usage_subcommand parses the Usage: line to suggest `ee <subcommand> --help`. Updated write_parse_error repair selection to prefer subcommand help when no `did you mean` is available.

title: Populate error.details.recovery[] across DomainError emission sites that currently leave details empty
deferred_reason: Cross-cutting refactor across ContextPackError/StorageError/DomainError variants in ~49 sites. Needs separate bead with surface-by-surface inventory. AGENTS.md documents recovery[] is the structured contract — sites that only carry a prose `repair:` are partly out of compliance.
diff_sketch: For each `Database not found at ...` and similar storage/index errors, route through a helper that returns DomainError with structured recovery actions ({priority, kind, command, rationale}).

title: Normalize JSON output field naming — choose snake_case OR camelCase, then audit and migrate
deferred_reason: Breaking schema migration. The v0.2.0 milestone already plans the v1→v2 cutover; this is the natural moment to lock down naming convention. AGENTS.md already documents `content`/`content_truncated`/`content_preview` (snake_case); `ee init` is the outlier emitting `databasePath`/`dryRun`/`eeDir`/`indexDir`.
diff_sketch: Pick canonical convention (recommendation: snake_case to match memory body fields). Update render_init_json (and any siblings) to emit `database_path`, `dry_run`, etc.

title: Generic `repair: "ee --help"` in non-clap DomainError::Usage paths — replace with command-specific repair hints
deferred_reason: Each `DomainError::Usage { repair: Some("ee --help".to_string()), .. }` site has a different command context. Mechanical replacement risks regressing copy that was deliberately scoped. Needs per-site audit.
